name: Fairmont Taghazout Bay
insider_take: This stunning beachfront resort sits on Morocco's legendary surf coast, where world-class waves meet luxury hospitality in the heart of Berber culture.
whats_special: Taghazout Bay is Morocco's premier surf destination, hosting international competitions and attracting wave riders from around the globe. The hotel overlooks the famous Anchor Point break, one of the world's most consistent right-hand point breaks. The property seamlessly blends Moroccan architecture with modern luxury, featuring traditional argan oil treatments at the spa - a nod to the region's "liquid gold" that's indigenous to this area.
pro_tip: Book your stay during March-April or September-November for optimal surf conditions and fewer crowds, when swells are consistent but the intense summer heat has passed.
dont_miss: Watch the sunrise surf sessions from your balcony at Anchor Point, explore the colorful fishing village of Taghazout with its authentic tagine spots, and take a day trip to nearby Paradise Valley's natural pools and palm oases. The hotel's rooftop offers spectacular views of the Atlantic coastline stretching toward Agadir.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Morocco's Atlantic coast
World-class surfing destination with consistent waves
Luxurious Fairmont amenities and service standards
Authentic Moroccan cultural experience in coastal setting
cons: Remote location requiring travel from major cities
Limited nightlife and urban entertainment options
